title: Dietary behaviours, beliefs, and information pathways among patients with inflammatory rheumatic diseases: a multicentre cross-sectional study
summary: Many people with inflammatory rheumatic diseases are interested in whether nutrition may influence their disease or symptoms. This study investigates the importance patients attribute to nutrition, whether they changed their diet after diagnosis, their use of dietary supplements, and their sources of nutrition-related information. We also assess previous counselling and patients' preferences for nutrition-related support within rheumatology care. Adult patients attending two rheumatology outpatient services in Germany are invited to complete a one-time anonymous digital questionnaire lasting approximately ten minutes. No additional examinations or treatments are performed.
conditions: Other systemic involvement of connective tissue
